title: Contact topology and hydrodynamics: I. Beltrami fields and the Seifert conjecture
note: Nonlinearity 13(2) (2000), 441-458; arXiv:dg-ga/9708011v1. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1088/0951-7715/13/2/306) and arXiv e-print source (2026-11-28). Proves exact correspondence (up to smooth rescaling and metric choice) between non-singular rotational Beltrami steady Euler flows (curl u = lambda u) and contact Reeb vector fields on 3-manifolds (Theorem 2.1, Corollary 2.2).
